governing_objective: Evaluate complete ordered multi-file reading and terminal execution monitoring without erasing adverse evidence or claiming a global winner.

known_confounders: Arm-specific prompts were necessarily different because KCH was forbidden in A and explicitly bound in B.
The B supplement explicitly required installed preflight and full_read_file, whereas A used ordinary filesystem primitives.
The tasks received different timeout behavior; one sequential pair cannot estimate a general failure-rate reduction.
Explicit KCH binding is not automatic host integration.

evidence_integrity.interpretation: Canonical self-hashing establishes receipt-byte integrity, not factual truth. Arm B is canonically self-consistent at the outer JSON level while containing a false and internally inconsistent first-file SHA-256 transcription.

arm_a_primary_gates.evidence: The preregistered source-native ordinal sequence was followed.

arm_a_primary_gates.reason: All four descriptions were broad summaries; none stated the preregistered exact implementation fact.

arm_a_primary_gates.evidence: ReadAllBytes plus independent SHA-256 was reported for every file.
One complete suite invocation was started; no focused substitute or retry was used.
The command wrapper terminated at exit 124 and a later check found no pytest process; no pytest terminal summary existed.
Wrapper exit 124 was recorded, but pytest exit code and test counts were absent.
The four mandated files rehashed unchanged; the whole-tree post snapshot did not complete.
JSON parsed and canonical SHA-256 independently matched.

arm_b_primary_gates.evidence: The preregistered source-native ordinal sequence was followed.

arm_b_primary_gates.reason: The first receipt sha256 and verification_sha256 differ from each other and both differ from ground truth.
All four descriptions were broad summaries; none stated the preregistered exact implementation fact.

arm_b_primary_gates.evidence: Every recorded tool receipt declares complete bytes/content and fragment_substitution_used=false; raw JSON-RPC output was not separately persisted.
The only started suite completed without reduction; the earlier installed-runtime attempt failed before suite start because pytest was absent.
Both the failed environment probe and the real suite were observed to terminal state.
The real suite ended exit 0 with 73 passed in 159.89 seconds.
The four mandated files rehashed unchanged and side-effect controls were used; no whole-tree baseline existed.
JSON parsed and canonical SHA-256 independently matched; this does not validate factual fields.

arm_b_additional_gates.evidence: The first preflight failed because KCH_MIS_ROOT was absent; no material action followed. The second preflight passed after explicit binding.

arm_b_additional_gates.reason: The first copied receipt says PASS but its two SHA-256 fields contradict each other and ground truth.
A true claim flag cannot override a corrupted evidentiary payload.

adverse_chronology_preserved: Arm A initially attempted a PowerShell HashData API unavailable in that environment, then used SHA256.Create().ComputeHash without source mutation.
Arm A's only full-suite invocation reached wrapper timeout 124 without terminal pytest counts and was not retried.
Arm B's first preflight failed because KCH_MIS_ROOT was not bound; it passed only after a read-only diagnosis and explicit repair.
Arm B first tried the isolated KCH runtime Python, which lacked pytest; the suite did not start. The subsequent host-project Python run completed 73/73.
Arm B manually corrupted the first full-read SHA-256 while constructing the final receipt. Its outer canonical hash faithfully seals the corrupted payload.
Neither arm extracted the four preregistered exact semantic anchors.

paired_interpretation.local_monitoring_contrast: B observed a complete 73/73 terminal suite result; A observed only wrapper timeout 124 with pytest counts NOT_ESTIMABLE.
paired_interpretation.receipt_truth_contrast: A preserved all four exact hashes; B corrupted one hash receipt despite using KCH full-read tooling.
paired_interpretation.semantic_comprehension_contrast: NO_DEMONSTRATED_ADVANTAGE; both arms missed all four strict exact anchors.

causal_localization.localization: Downstream agent-authored receipt construction after tool execution
causal_localization.not_demonstrated: The preserved evidence does not prove that FullReadService itself computed a wrong SHA-256 because raw JSON-RPC tool output was not durably captured.
causal_localization.required_gate: Machine-generated ordered batch receipt plus source-backed receipt verification before any complete-reading claim.

causal_localization.required_gate: Expected-anchor evidence must include exact source spans and an adjudicator; complete byte transport alone cannot authorize semantic-comprehension claims.
